correctness.rationale: Layer rigidity follows because every trim accepting path has length exactly two; each middle state contributes a full rectangular portion of the relation. If a final state had three middle neighbors then two four-cycles would share vertices s,u,f, contrary to cactus. Thus f>=ceil(m/2) and m>=b. Pairing rectangle states gives edge-disjoint four-cycles sharing only the initial state and meets the count. Sperner antichain proof yields the inequality-language cover rank.
